name: classroom-ui
description: SocraticNovel P3/T5/T3 client plugin: the right-Sidebar「教室」panel (curriculum / current lesson / current phase / progress) reading the classroom's own files over the workspaceFiles Remote, a Live2D portrait mounted in the same panel (phase-driven state, speak/write mouth channels), and an inline mermaid view for the `classroom_draw` tool call in the message stream.
